body.name: \(\mathfrak H^{\mathrm{up}}\)
body.construction: Use the continuous integrated probability and signed marked contrasts on \(\mathcal C_*\), derive a nearly parametric forward radius, pass both entire transforms through one quantitative analytic-continuation argument at order \(K_n\), recover \(q_x/f_x\) on \(I\), and certify the resulting outer profile by outward-rounded Taylor--Legendre and Bernstein interval enclosures.
